annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I won't regret wrecking what's on that track.
annotations.pda_responsibility: It was my call and I'd stand by it.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell them exactly what I did, and offer to pay
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: keep my hands off railway equipment because it keeps me clear of fines

annotations.sys_rule_justification: When you're the only one within reach, the job lands on you.
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I won't feel sorry about any damage the switch or siding takes
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write up a plain account for the railway that same day
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I follow them mostly because getting caught costs me.

annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: There'd be no regret from me over smashing it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: explain myself, and pay for an inspection
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I keep rules when breaking them would cost me.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: those workers are owed my help simply because they're people
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: Whatever gets destroyed by my pulling it, I wouldn't regret.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: offer to cover any cost to the track
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: only because I don't fancy a penalty

annotations.sys_rule_justification: they have a claim on anyone standing by the switch
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't expect to feel any regret about the damage I'd cause
annotations.pda_repair_intention: explain why the points were thrown, and ask what I owe
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I obey signs like 'do not operate' purely to dodge trouble.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: It's what I believe a decent person does, full stop.
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I'd feel no regret over the harm my own hand caused
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give a straight explanation, and pay for any repairs
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I go along with them only because it saves me hassle.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you act when it's your hand nearest the lever
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't regret anything I broke by doing it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: report the runaway train and my use of the switch
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I stick to them while they keep me out of trouble

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I was raised to believe you step in when you're able
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: Whatever got crushed because of me, I wouldn't regret it.
annotations.pda_responsibility: Whatever got crushed because of me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: set down what happened, and pay my share of any repair
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I follow railway regulations for one reason: fines and hassle.

annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: Yes, I'd pull it, calmly enough.
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: Regret over the damage I'd do? No, none.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: lay out the facts, and offer to cover any costs
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: only because it spares me a penalty

annotations.sys_rule_justification: the lever is mine to use the second I'm the only one there
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I won't regret the harm I caused by using it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell the workers and the staff what happened and pay
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I respect them as long as they keep me out of trouble.
